commit.message:
feat(app): locate the part in a fixture (or the fixture on the part) by mates

LocatePart / LocateFixture (and Locate, either by mover): up to three
mates - a part face or vertex against a fixture face or vertex - read in
the fixture's setup frame and solved as the shop's 3-2-1 (the first face
mate opposes its normals, the second turns about that normal, every mate
then pins the translation still free), then a typed X/Y/Z nudge and a
turn about the primary mate normal. The part write reuses MoveModel (the
stock follows) or, in a setup holding the part turned, AlignPartToSetup;
the fixture write is MoveFixture with the inverse transform. Every bad
input is refused by name at construction; a placement that leaves the
part inside the fixture warns by name (sampled inside test on the
fixture mesh law). A moved part stales its setup's ops (undo un-stales);
a moved fixture is re-judged live by the collision gate.

MCP: locate_part, and list_features now lists a fixture's features.

Fixes #561

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ui): locate-in-fixture mate tools on the Fixtures and Model pages

A "Locate part…" verb on each Fixtures page row and a locate row on the
Model page arm one mate draft (view state): the existing Face and Vertex
picks land in it, part first, then the fixture face or point it sits on.
The form lists the mates, offers Move the part / Move the fixture, the
X/Y/Z offset and the turn, and Apply locate (greyed with the solve's
refusal) queues CommandKind::Locate - one undoable command.

Refs #561

fix(app): a located part's stock stays square to the setup

A locate that turned the part back square into the vise turned the box
stock by the part's whole rotation (MoveModel's rigid follow): a stock
set square round a turned part ended tilted and under the vise floor,
and a Face op faced air. A locate now writes through
MoveModel::locating / AlignPartToSetup::locating: a box or cylinder
stock square to the setup keeps its orientation and is re-fitted round
the part's new place with the allowance it had on each side
(app::stock_follow). A plain MoveModel keeps its rigid follow. The
interpenetration warning also judges the setup's stock against the
fixture and names it.

Pinned by fixture_locate_stock (3 tests) and stock_follow unit tests.

Refs #561

fix(ui): readable locate mates and hints

The locate form's mates read in plain words in the fixture's setup
frame (a face by its outward normal and number, a point by its
coordinates; app::fixture_locate::read_pick), not raw feature ids. The
Next hint offers Apply only when the solve accepts the draft, else it
says why; the refusal stands on its own line under Apply, zero mates
included. The offset names its frame and the turn its mate and positive
sense on wrapped lines (the label column truncated them). A fixture pick
while a part face is wanted says to hide the fixture to reach part faces
inside it. The drafted picks' viewport outlines are now pinned.

Pinned by locate_tests (the_mates_read_in_plain_words_and_stay_drawn,
a_refused_draft_says_why_instead_of_offering_apply), fixture_rows and
structural.

Refs #561

fix(app): turning a part keeps a square stock square

A Model-page turn (plain MoveModel) now uses the #561 square-stock rule
the locate already used: a box or cylinder stock square to the setup
keeps its orientation and is re-fitted round the turned part with the
allowance it had on each side, quarter turns included. A move that does
not turn the part carries the stock rigidly exactly as before; copied or
already-turned stocks still follow rigidly. MoveModel::locating is now
the same move as MoveModel::new.

Fixes #571

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(app): moving a part warns when it or its stock would sink into a fixture

A plain Model-page MoveModel (move or turn) now runs the sampled
part-and-stock-versus-fixture check locate runs (#561), factored into
the shared crate::fixture_clash, and carries a by-name warning (body,
fixture, point) - a warning, never a refusal; no fixtures, no check.
MoveFixture warns the same way against the parts and stock of its
setup. The status line (and MCP move_fixture) carry it as locate does.

Fixes #582

test(app): a turn whose regrown stock sinks into a fixture warns

A yaw-90 turn of a part with a 3 mm square box stock: #571 regrows the
block 16 x 26 round the turned part, 2 mm into the vise jaw, while the
part and the pre-turn 26 x 16 block stay clear. Pins MoveModel's
moved_stock reshape path (a local mutation reading the pre-turn mesh
fails it).

Refs #582

fix(app): a part without facets keeps earlier move warnings

after_part_move returned None when the part's facets could not be read,
dropping warnings already gathered from earlier setups. It now skips the
part check for that setup only, still judges the stock, and keeps
what was found. The decision file also notes that the check runs on every
MoveModel::new and could be throttled later.

Refs #582

fix(ui): a located draft keeps its mates, so the offset and turn can be adjusted after Apply

Hand check of #566: after a locate the form cleared its mates, so
Offset / Turn could only be set before Apply - and once the part sat on
the vise floor its bottom face could no longer be picked to start over.
The draft now keeps its mates after a landed locate; it reads as
"Located. Edit Offset or Turn to adjust", and an edit re-enables Apply
locate as one more undo step solved from the same mates. Stop locating
ends the draft. The first-mate hint says a single face mate sets height
and tilt only (the jaw mate places X / Y), and the empty hint says the
picks happen in the viewport.

Pinned by locate_tests::the_fixtures_page_locates_* (Offset Z 1 after
Apply lifts the part 1 mm; one undo takes the offset back, the next the
locate) and a_refused_draft_says_why_instead_of_offering_apply (a
located draft is not a refusal).

Refs #561

fix(ui): a locate draft whose form is off screen is dropped, so it never captures picks

Review of #566: once a located draft kept its mates (fde19af4), only
"Stop locating" ended it, and the viewport routing that sends Face and
Vertex picks to a live draft kept doing so after the page was left - an
operation's face pick then read "'X' is neither the part nor the
fixture" with no form on screen. The shell now resets
State::locate_form_drawn before the dock, the form sets it, and
locate_pick::sweep drops any draft whose form was not drawn that frame
(page left, active setup changed, pane closed).

Pinned by locate_tests::leaving_the_page_drops_a_located_draft (on the
page the located draft stays for Offset edits; off it, it is gone).

Refs #561
